//: Per-model reasoning/thinking adapter. Maps a model to the request-body fields
//1: that enable its deep-thinking mode on its host. Resolution order at call time:
//2: exact 'provider/model' -> logical name -> model family -> '*' default.
//3: 'body' is shallow-merged into the chat-completions request when reasoning is on.
//4: Every host exposes thinking differently, so these are filled in per model as we
//5: confirm the exact param from each provider's docs (editable, zero code changes).
//6: Leave 'body' empty {} to rely on big token budget + the model's default behaviour.
//7: IMPORTANT: the SAME logical model uses DIFFERENT param shapes per host - NVIDIA
//8: NIM uses chat_template_kwargs (or top-level reasoning_effort for newer models),
//9: OpenRouter uses top-level reasoning:{enabled|effort}, Cloudflare's newer slots use
//10: top-level reasoning_effort or chat_template_kwargs. Multi-host models are keyed by
//11: exact 'provider/model' so the wrong shape never leaks to a host that would 400 it
//12: (a 400 blacklists the slot - keep shapes exact).
//13: Capability sweep 2026-06: ctx windows + extra knobs recorded in notes below.
//14: VERIFIED 2026-06 (PROVIDER-SKILLS task): fetched each provider's docs page via
//15: curl and cross-checked the JSON shape. Sources:
//19: - NVIDIA NIM (deepseek-v4-pro/flash, nemotron-3-ultra): the docs explicitly say
//20: 'Snippets translate this field into the model chat_template_kwargs' - i.e. the
//21: CANONICAL API is the top-level `reasoning_effort` field; sending chat_template_kwargs
//22: directly also works (the underlying shape). We send the top-level form because that
//23: is the documented/supported API and matches the OpenAI-compatible shape on other hosts.
//26: - Cloudflare: per-model schema exposes either reasoning_effort OR chat_template_kwargs
//28: - GitHub Models: Azure OpenAI-compatible. phi-4-reasoning strips system prompts, so
//29: the quirk folds system into user; deepseek-r1 reasons natively (no param).

*.note: default: no special param; rely on token budget + native behaviour

glm-5.1.note: NVIDIA NIM only; confirmed. ctx 131k in/out; emits reasoning_content. NIM ref page 404s but captest-verified.

deepseek-v4-pro.note: NVIDIA NIM canonical API (verified https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/deepseek-ai-deepseek-v4-pro-infer). reasoning_effort: none|high|max, default 'high'. NIM internally translates to chat_template_kwargs. 'max' thinks past every timeout we have (captest judge killed at 35min still thinking); override per-request when truly needed. ctx 1M.

deepseek-v4-flash.note: NVIDIA NIM canonical API (verified https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/deepseek-ai-deepseek-v4-flash-infer). reasoning_effort: none|high|max, default 'high'. Snippets translate to chat_template_kwargs. ctx 262k.

deepseek-r1.note: github R1-0528 reasons natively; no param. 403s on our tier - kept for when the tier rises. CF r1-distill removed (captest: hallucinated a deadlock fix)

phi-4-reasoning.note: reasoning model by design (github models; streams its think trace). GitHub strips/overrides custom system prompts for this model (captest: in_tokens=233, never saw the input) - quirk folds system into the user message

nvidia/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6.note: NVIDIA NIM Kimi thinking (verified https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/moonshotai-kimi-k2-6-infer). chat_template_kwargs:{thinking:true|false}; no top-level alias. ctx 256k; vision-capable (MoonViT)

openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6:free.note: OpenRouter reasoning toggle (verified https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/reasoning-tokens). ctx 262k. Could also use reasoning:{effort:'high'} for stronger thinking.

cloudflare/@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6.note: CF schema exposes reasoning_effort (no chat_template_kwargs); ctx 262k; tools. CF deprecates max_tokens -> send max_completion_tokens or thinking gets cut mid-trace (seen live)

kimi-k2.6.note: fallback for unlisted hosts: no thinking param

nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b.note: NVIDIA NIM canonical API (verified https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-infer). reasoning_effort: none|medium|high (default high). reasoning_budget: -1..32768 (default 16384); -1 disables enforcement. Both fields are top-level; NIM translates to chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_budget internally. ctx up to 1M. extra knobs: force_nonempty_content:true REQUIRED when combining tools+thinking; reasoning_budget is soft (closes at newline before budget or +500 tok)

cloudflare/@cf/nvidia/nemotron-3-120b-a1.note: CF schema exposes chat_template_kwargs + reasoning_effort; ctx 256k; tools. max_completion_tokens (max_tokens deprecated on CF)

nvidia/google/gemma-4-31b-it.note: NVIDIA NIM canonical API (verified https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/google-gemma-4-31b-it-infer). chat_template_kwargs:{enable_thinking:true|false}; no top-level alias. ctx 256k; vision (image+video). rec sampling: temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 64

cloudflare/@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it.note: CF schema exposes chat_template_kwargs + reasoning_effort; ctx 256k; vision. max_completion_tokens (max_tokens deprecated on CF)

gpt-oss-120b.note: CF chat-completions schema does NOT list reasoning_effort (responses API only) - a rejected param would 400-blacklist the slot, so effort stays default. raise via system prompt 'Reasoning: high' if needed. ctx 128k

step-flash.note: no thinking param documented; ctx 256k; vision; 100-350 tok/s

web_search.//: Provider-native web-search adapter. Each provider exposes web search differently
web_search.//2: uses this map to decide whether to call the provider's NATIVE web search tool
web_search.//3: or fall back to our web_tools.py injection (Tavily/DuckDuckGo). 'body' is
web_search.//4: shallow-merged into the chat-completions request when native web search is on.
web_search.//5: Per-host entries (provider/model) take precedence; '*' is the default.

*.note: default: no native web search - fall back to web_tools.py injection

openrouter/*.note: OpenRouter web plugin (verified https://openrouter.ai/docs/features/web-search). Model-agnostic grounding via Exa/native/parallel/perplexity. Default engine: native for OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Perplexity/xAI, Exa for others. Exa costs $0.005/req (still works for :free models but consumes OR credits). Equivalent shortcut: append :online to model slug.

openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6:free.note: OpenRouter :free model - Exa only (no native engine); 5 results is a good default. Costs $0.005/req in OR credits.

nvidia/*.note: NVIDIA NIM does not expose a native web-search tool on chat-completions; use web_tools.py injection.

cloudflare/*.note: Cloudflare Workers AI has no native web-search tool on chat-completions; use web_tools.py injection.

github-models/*.note: GitHub Models does not expose a native web-search tool; use web_tools.py injection.

privatemodeai/*.note: Privacy-first proxy has no native web-search tool; use web_tools.py injection.

opencode-zen/*.note: OpenCode Zen has no native web-search tool; use web_tools.py injection.

opencode-go/*.note: OpenCode Go has no native web-search tool; use web_tools.py injection.
